description: tests/test_model.py is the unit test for the Tether/Artifact data model and its validate() invariants in tether/model.py: UUIDv7 id format, schema_version == 1, non-empty paths/fingerprints/description, no self-tether (a.path != b.path), and created_at <= refreshed_at. Any change to the validation rules or struct fields in model.py must be reflected in these assertions, and changed expectations here signal a deliberate model change.
